title: New ALMA constraints on the star-forming interstellar medium at low metallicity: a 50 pc view of the blue compact dwarf galaxy SBS 0335-052
question: How much cold molecular gas (CO) and cold dust is present in the very low-metallicity blue compact dwarf SBS 0335-052 at 50 pc resolution?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 0.011 mJy/beam; CO rms 0.41 mJy/beam at 5 km/s

evidence.quote: We use *Herschel* photometry at a resolution $>$5 arcsec from (cite: remy-2015).
ALMA band 7 (346 GHz) data from (cite: hunt-2014) at $\sim$0.6 arcsec resolution

what.value: VLA SSC fluxes and free-free models

evidence.quote: radio continuum data from the VLA (1.3 to 6 cm) at $\sim$0.5 arcsec resolution and SSC-extracted fluxes from (cite: johnson-2009)
SBS 0335$-$052 was observed at 1.5–22 arcsec resolution with the VLA (1.3 to 21 cm) by (cite: hunt-2004).

what.value: HI line width 50 km/s and HI mass

evidence.quote: Assuming a broad line width of 50 km s$^{-1}$, as measured from H i(cite: ekta-2009)

recipe.method: Standard CASA calibration, flagging, clean with natural weighting

recipe.goal: Measure continuum fluxes of S1, S2, region S
recipe.method: Fit 2D ellipses constrained by beam shape for each SSC, masking the other; circular aperture of 0.5 arcsec radius for region S

recipe.goal: CO(2-1) luminosity upper limit and alpha_CO lower limits
recipe.method: 3-sigma L_CO limit assuming 50 km/s line width; convert to CO(1-0); assume depletion times of 2 Gyr, 0.2 Gyr, 20 Myr with SSC-derived SFRs to bound alpha_CO
key_parameters: line width 50 km/s; solid angle 0.044 arcsec^2

recipe.goal: SED analysis and cold dust mass
recipe.method: Subtract free-free from Johnson 2009 S1/S2 models; fit modified black-body to ALMA excess in addition to PACS MBB (59 K, beta=2); F-test for dust excess in S1
key_parameters: T_dust <= 14 K upper limit from PACS 160 um

evidence.quote: we derive a conservative 3-$\sigma$ $L_{\rm CO(2-1)}$ limit of $3.6\times10^4$ K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$
this corresponds to a $L_{\rm CO(1-0)}$ limit of $4.5\times10^4$ K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$

answer_key.quantity: alpha_CO lower limit, cloud depletion time (20 Myr)

evidence.quote: are around $10^2$ M$_{\odot}$ pc$^{-2}$ (K km s$^{-1}$)$^{-1}$ for cloud depletion times (20 Myr)

answer_key.quantity: alpha_CO lower limit, whole-galaxy depletion times (0.2-2 Gyr)

evidence.quote: $10^3 - 10^4$ M$_{\odot}$ pc$^{-2}$ (K km s$^{-1}$)$^{-1}$, amongst the highest, for whole-galaxy depletion times
which gives a mass $M_{\rm dust}\simeq1.5\times10^5$ M$_{\odot}$
With a temperature of 10 K, the required mass is $\sim3\times10^5$ M$_{\odot}$.

answer_key.quantity: Molecular gas mass range from depletion times

evidence.quote: we find molecular gas masses of $5\times10^6-8\times10^8$ M$_{\odot}$

answer_key.quantity: CO clump beam filling factor upper limit

evidence.quote: we estimate a beam filling factor for the CO-emitting clumps of less than 33 per cent

score_reason: Public data and a short recipe, but imaging parameters and SED fitting details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public archive data with numeric results (fluxes, upper limit), though some imaging settings are unstated.
